text: On the left side of Harbour City’s attacking half, about 6 metres from the Seabrook Town goal at the far end, Marek Barros receives a sharp through ball from teammate Joon Whitfield. Barros takes a quick shot with his foot, but it is blocked just before it can reach the goal. This chance comes after a patient buildup starting deep in Harbour City’s own half, using short passes to break through the defense. The score remains 0-0. [#670] [#672]
